notes: 2026-10-25 review fail by reviewer: BLOCKING: apps/backend/internal/activity/transfers.go:57,92 - the wallet-transfer lateral join can now return an invoice id with a NULL number, and scanTransfer dereferences *number. The claim that wallet-transfer activity only concerns numbered invoices fails when money leaves an unnumbered link receiver for the owner's wallet without a booked deposit: a refund-authority settle after the deadline, a recover() of another enabled token, or the documented Arc native-USDC refund (money-safety.md) when the payer is the owner's own wallet. A probe in a scratch copy (wallet_transfers row from an unnumbered link invoice's receive address, then activity.Transfers) panicked: nil pointer dereference. That breaks GET /transactions, transactions.csv and statement.pdf (moneyapi/activity.go:116,301) for that profile, with no end, since such an invoice never gets a number. Fix: add 'AND m.number IS NOT NULL' to the lateral join, plus a regression test. Non-blocking: (a) ledger/process.go:176-187 takes the profile row lock before funded/balanced/deployed make second-RPC calls (up to BalanceTimeout 10s each), so Create (create.go:84), Send (send.go:36) and token, wallet and client saves wait. No deadlock found: no transaction that holds the profile lock then locks an unnumbered invoice, and replace() refuses one before cancel. Moving the numbering just before Commit shortens the hold. (b) balance.go:62-64 'pending' counts an unnumbered link invoice's unbooked deposits, so the owner sees money they can't trace. Name it or filter it. (c) PROJECT.md R-141 'leave it out, so no email names it' gives the wrong cause: no email names it because Paid, Held, Settled and Receipt follow a booked deposit, and Send and Reminder need guarded owner routes. Checked: process.go numbers before outbox.Queue; payer_email.go:71; events.go:38. (d) architecture.md '...invoice's is null...' leaves out a noun, and 'It and the details never change' now reads wrong. (e) tasks.json acceptance line 2 changed during the task: 'the invoice reads ... emails show it without one' was dropped. The new wording matches the code. Say so in the PR. (f) Create accepts LinkID together with Replaces, Repeat or Reminders. replace() scans n.number into int64 (create.go:335) and would fail. The API can't reach this (LinkID is json:"-"), but F298 must refuse those combinations. (g) The 00065 down migration's SET NOT NULL fails once unnumbered link invoices exist. (h) Add a test for a link invoice where the payer picks the token, paid on a second option: the scratch probe showed the main and option rows both got number 1 and the next invoice got 2. Verified correct: the trigger guard against 00052 (diffed, only coalesce(OLD.number, NEW.number) and the link_id branch changed, and down equals 00052); the unique index invoices_profile_number allows NULLs; no gap on rollback; no double use, because the profile row update re-reads invoice_seq after the lock wait; the group lock serializes options. Readers: owed held, events, notify, reminders, job (coalesce) and revisions are safe by construction. TestLinkInvoiceNumbers checks are not vacuous (an overdue due date puts the invoice in Owed; the detected-deposit Activity row is covered). tasks.behavior: The web typecheck checks every file each run, so a stale build cache can't hide type errors
acceptance: With a stale apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo that records no errors, pnpm typecheck still reports a type error in a file that depends on a changed one
notes: 2026-10-25 review pass by reviewer: Pass. Reproduced in a copy-on-write clone outside the repo (apps/web at da6e023 + the one nullable line in invoiceSummarySchema, author's f297 cache as apps/web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo). Old command (next typegen && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json): exit 0, 0 errors, check time 0.015s. New command (tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p tsconfig.json): exit 1, 11 errors in 5 files, same list as an old-command run with no cache; the stale cache file was left byte-identical. The bad cache records the HEAD schema (version 11add9, nullable shape signature 287a6b) beside lib/invoices.ts at da6e023 with no errors, a state no correct check produces; a normal edit sequence (da6e023 -> HEAD -> da6e023 + nullable line) from a fresh cache reported the 11 errors, so the tsgo 7.0.2 trigger stays unknown. Lever: --incremental false on the CLI overrides incremental:true and neither reads nor writes the buildinfo; ui-web and design-tokens are not incremental and have no buildinfo. Cost: full script 0.9s vs 0.6s with a warm cache (M4 Pro). Not blocking, for follow-up: (1) next build runs its own incremental type check: runTypeCheckCli.js passes --tsBuildInfoFile .next/cache/.tsbuildinfo when tsconfig has incremental; tsc with those exact args and the stale cache exits 0 with 0 errors, so pnpm build can print Finished TypeScript over errors. The required typecheck, pre-commit hook and fresh CI still catch them. Setting incremental:false in apps/web/tsconfig.json would cover both; Next re-adds incremental:true only when the key is missing (writeConfigurationDefaults.js). Name this in the PR at least. (2) turbo typecheck hashes ignore root tsconfig.base.json (globalCacheInputs.files is empty; editing noUncheckedIndexedAccess there left all three typecheck hashes unchanged, an apps/web/tsconfig.json edit changed the web hash), so a root config change replays a cached pass; fix with globalDependencies [tsconfig.base.json]. (3) F299 has no refs. Commands: harness show F299; git diff; turbo run typecheck --filter=@forwend/web --dry=json; tsc runs in the clone with and without the stale cache; tsc --extendedDiagnostics; /usr/bin/time x3. Clone and temp files removed; main tree unchanged.
